dedupe_keys.name: forecast solar pv forecast api client

description: forecast_solar is a Python client for retrieving photovoltaic generation forecasts from the forecast.solar service. A user supplies site location, panel orientation and system details to the service through the library; it returns expected solar generation for upcoming days. Geographic coverage follows locations accepted by the upstream service. The repository README documents asynchronous calls and installation, and GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the client. A limitation is that this licence applies to the code, not necessarily to the upstream forecast data or its rate limits. Forecast accuracy also depends on weather inputs and the quality of panel configuration. The client can supply short-term rooftop PV scenarios to grid or building-energy simulations. The related catalogue ERA5 record is an independent weather reanalysis, not this forecast service or client. No service account, forecast data or Python package was downloaded.
name: forecast_solar PV forecast API client
